source_text: Saepe repetitur descriptio tabernaculi — cum Deus praecipit, cum Moyses populo, cum fabricatur, cum dedicatur. Necessaria commemoratio.
pass_a_gloss: Often is-repeated description of-tabernacle — when God commands, when Moses to-people, when it-is-fashioned, when it-is-dedicated. Necessary reminder.
pass_b_english: The tabernacle’s description is often repeated — when God commands, when Moses tells the people, when it is built, when it is dedicated. Necessary reminder.
